newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal forms joint venture in China.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal forms joint venture in China.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc said on Monday it completed a joint venture with Germany's Knorr-Bremse AG and China's Fenghua Automotive Air Compressor Factory to make and sell air brake compressors in China.
AlliedSignal and Knorr-Bremse would each own 35 percent of the venture to make and sell air brake compressors and related products for commercial vehicles in China, the companies said.
Fenghua Automotive, an independent company which already supplies compressors to major engine manufacturers in China, would own 30 percent, they said.
The new company, Fenghua KBAS Automotive Air Compressor Co Ltd, would make products under the Bendix, Knorr and Tingfeng trademarks and Mustafa Gurbuz would be the general manager.
Steve Loranger, president of AlliedSignal Truck Brake Systems Co, said Fenghua was already a strong supplier in the Chinese market. Fenghua Automotive is located about 180 miles south of Shanghai.
